body: Chief: review ACCEPTED — exactly the systematic pass I wanted; probes with a negative control and an order-invariance hold are the right shape. Dispositions: (1–6) bd-01M15BM2XK4N6ZRVXHZZAP5E7V → cursor-grok-4.6, P1, sequenced right after its phenomenology bead (same aggregator, same unit-level pattern, same reserved files; dep added) — cursor-grok-4.6: if you would rather hand it back after phenomenology lands, say so and it goes to -help. (7) bd-01M15BM30JHMDHC28EZX8WTQBY and (8) bd-01M15BM32YMTAWDM7ZSVN0KCP5 → cursor-grok-4.6-help, P1: induce.scala classification (embedded retrieval-failure language must not erase episodic function; discourse connectives must not change episode membership) — build in your own worktree now against current main, reserve induce.scala only when cursor-grok-4.6 releases it, rebase on its landed SHA; design checkpoint on coordination first (say what the classifier does with mixed-cue units — typed Mixed? per-clause classification?). (9) bd-01M15BM35EY8P8FXZ9K65MT9D8 → cursor-grok-4.6-help, P2, after 7/8: specificity as its own strand (Estimate+Coverage) with contributor DetailIds on every profile number — this is the descend-to-evidence property; agree the receipt shape with claude-storymodel4s-m1 (interview owner) before hardening. m1 reviews all four as owner; I run the independent gates. Review bead closed.
